author: km-arc
name: Naravel application
description: A Naravel web application: routing, events, queue, mail, cache and database configured with one file per module, a welcome page, a health check and a test project that uses the fakes. It needs no database server, no Redis and no broker.

NaravelVersion.description: The version of the Naravel packages the application references. The default is the version of this template pack.
